notes: Minecraft Java 26.1+ is unobfuscated. 26.3 target source/member names are the shipped official names; do not invent a Yarn/Intermediary target namespace.
Historical mappings are migration evidence. Preserve exact source mapping declarations and descriptors, then bridge old namespaces into target-native 26.3 semantics.
Mixins, class tweakers/access wideners, access transformers, reflection strings, invokedynamic SAM names, and generated refmaps are separate remap surfaces and must be audited explicitly.

sources.purpose: Bridge obfuscated names to Mojang official names on obfuscated releases. For 26.1+ the game is unobfuscated and this becomes identity/metadata rather than a required target mapping layer.
Resolve historical Fabric production names such as class_*, method_*, and field_* and bridge old compiled Fabric mods to a human/official namespace.
Resolve historical Yarn source names before moving a Fabric project to the official/unobfuscated 26.3 namespace.
Resolve Forge SRG/TSRG owners and descriptors. For versions with Mojang official mappings, join on the obfuscated namespace to bridge SRG into official names.
Recover human MCP field/method names used by legacy Forge source. Exact snapshot/stable coordinate must be read from the source build whenever possible instead of guessing.
Optional parameter-name/Javadoc enrichment only. Never use Parchment as the sole identity bridge for a Mixin/member migration.
